messages:
Faye Sato: Hey folks! 👋 I'm Faye — just joined Platform Runtime from a tiny solar-startup in Osaka. Excited to dig into batching and latency stuff. Also I make very serious bento boxes and will bring one to the SF office next week. :sun_with_face: :bento:
Mira Patel: welcome Faye!! :tada: bento obligations accepted. which day are you in the office?
Faye Sato: I'll be in on Tuesday and Thursday this week. mornings are best — I bring extra matcha cookies sometimes. :cookie:
Noah Kim: welcome! would love to see the bento art. also curious re: solar cooker stories — we have a ridiculous sun-loving plant in the kitchen that needs attention. :sun_with_face: :seedling:
Rajesh Bhaskar: hey Faye, welcome aboard. if you're into early mornings, join our 9:30 sync on tuesday — we usually grab coffee after. ps. favorite coffee shop near the office is Blue Chair. :coffee:
Faye Sato: thanks Rajesh! count me in for the 9:30 sync. I'll bring a mini solar-powered phone charger as a silly icebreaker. :battery:
Mira Patel: omg that is peak new-hire energy. :laughing: also heads-up — sticker station by the front desk in case you want to rep your bento artistry.
Devex Bot: Welcome message posted to #new-hires and added Faye to the "Team Lunch" Slack reminder.
Noah Kim: poll: sushi, biryani, or ramen for Tuesday lunch? vote with emoji. :sushi: = sushi, :rice_ball: = biryani, :ramen: = ramen
Faye Sato: :sushi: but i'm happy to follow the crowd.
Rajesh Bhaskar: :ramen: from me — but i'll happily eat whatever.
Mira Patel: :sushi:
Noah Kim: current tally: sushi 2, ramen 1. looks like sushi wins.
Faye Sato: perfect! see you Tuesday — I'll bring a tiny origami sun with the bento for whoever wants it. :sun_with_face: :smile:
Mira Patel: iconic. welcome again — excited to have you on infra/perf! :raised_hands:
